Key Statistical Takeaways on Return vs. Risk

  • High-Return Efficiency (NVDA): Delivered +1,120.05% cumulative return with 2.37% daily volatility—roughly half the volatility of CHK (4.55%).
  • Defensive Stability (JNJ): Recorded the lowest daily volatility among focus stocks (0.89%) while compounding a +53.49% gain.
  • Uncompensated Volatility (CHK): Highest daily return swings (4.55% std dev) resulted in an -85.12% cumulative drawdown, proving high volatility does not guarantee positive returns.

Trading Volume & Price Movement Insights

  • Liquidity Leaders: Bank of America (BAC) led the entire S&P 500 with 89.99B total shares traded (89.36M daily avg), followed by Apple (AAPL) at 45.49B shares (45.17M daily avg).
  • Volume Correlates with Move Magnitude, Not Direction: Across all 6 focus stocks, correlation between volume and signed daily return is near zero (-0.07 to +0.14), whereas correlation between volume and absolute return size is strong (+0.49 to +0.74)—spikes in volume accompany big news events regardless of direction.
